confidence_notes: I ran one RBA search and one Jeju price search. Aggregator prices for Jeju disagree with each other. The mid-range meal for two is the least certain food anchor because sources ranged from about $13 to $51, so I chose a bounded value. The RBA 0.6677 figure for 19 Nov 2026 came from a table whose age metadata was inconsistent. The RBA overview page gave 0.6720 for 18 Nov. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer price, not from direct Jeju data. The accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge, not from searches or live listings. They carry more uncertainty because July is peak season in Jeju.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on aggregator Jeju prices and on Korean provincial tourist cities such as Busan, with a restaurant premium for Jeju as an island resort destination.
